name: Inshuu Mura 2200
source:
――It is the newest village of tradition.

The year 2200.

An era in which humans began to abandon their physical bodies by connecting their brains to the network.

Oculus, an employee at a cybernetic body manufacturing company, hears a rumor while on duty that a colleague has gone missing.

The location is an undeveloped region cut off from the cyber network, where the culture of the old era still lingers strongly.

His department head gave him a single order.

To recover the cybernetic body worn by the missing employee.

But Oculus knows.

That this land is a mad village of madness—evolved through twisted faith and science.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3941930/Derevnya_tradiczij_2200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
——那是最新形态的因习村。

2200年。

人类通过将大脑接入网络，开始逐步舍弃血肉之躯的时代。

义体制造公司的职员奥库勒斯在当班执勤期间，听闻了一则同事离奇失踪的传闻。

失踪地点位于一处与赛博网络彻底隔绝、至今仍浓厚残留着旧时代风俗文化的未开发偏远地区。

部门主管只向他下达了一道命令：

回收失踪职员身上穿戴的那具义体。

然而奥库勒斯心知肚明。

那片土地，是一座在扭曲信仰与尖端科学交融演化下诞生的疯狂之村。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3941930/Derevnya_tradiczij_2200/]Steam[/url]]
